q1.label: 1. What is the intended use of the product?

options.treat_disease: Treat or prevent human disease / clinical condition
options.dietary_supplement: Dietary supplement / Ayurveda Aahar / nutritional support

options.classical: Exactly as in a classical Ayurvedic text (First Schedule)
options.modified_classical: Modified from a classical formulation (altered ratio / base)
options.synthetic: Synthetic or semi-synthetic molecule derived from plant structure

q3.label: 3. What is the physical form of the primary ingredients?

options.standardized_extract: Standardized extract with quantified bio-active markers
options.herb_mineral_mix: Mix of herbs and purified minerals/metals (bhasma/rasa-shastra)

options.new_process: New extraction, purification, or delivery process
options.new_therapeutic_use: New therapeutic use with documented clinical efficacy

q5.label: 5. What is the biological resource sourcing?

options.cultivated: Cultivated by applicant or contracted farmers
options.indian_supplier: Bought from an Indian commercial supplier / raw drug mandi
